name: Urea (46% N)
dosage: 1 bag (45kg) per acre as basal dose; split into 2-3 top dressings for better uptake.
targetUse: General nitrogen deficiency, promotes vegetative growth and leaf greening.
safety: Store in dry place away from moisture. Avoid direct contact with seeds during sowing.
description: Government-subsidised granular Urea, the most widely used nitrogenous fertilizer for all major crops across Maharashtra.

name: DAP (Di-Ammonium Phosphate)
dosage: 1 bag (50kg) per acre at sowing/basal application, placed 5cm below seed line.
targetUse: Root development and early plant vigor; corrects phosphorus deficiency.
safety: Keep away from direct seed contact to avoid germination damage.
description: High-analysis phosphatic fertilizer ideal for root establishment during sowing.

name: 10:26:26 NPK Complex
dosage: 1-1.5 bags per acre at basal stage depending on soil test report.
targetUse: Balanced flowering, root & fruit development; ideal for bulb and cash crops.
safety: Store away from moisture; use protective gloves during handling in bulk.
description: Balanced complex fertilizer suited for high potash-demanding crops like onion and sugarcane.

name: Zinc Sulphate 21%
dosage: 8-10 kg per acre mixed with soil at sowing; foliar spray 0.5% for quick correction.
targetUse: Corrects zinc deficiency — interveinal chlorosis, stunted growth, khaira disease in paddy.
safety: Avoid mixing directly with alkaline fertilizers.
description: Essential micronutrient supplement to correct hidden hunger in zinc-deficient soils.

name: Coragen (Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC)
dosage: 60 ml per acre in 200 litres of water for knapsack spray.
targetUse: Controls bollworm, fruit borer, stem borer and pod borer complex.
safety: Use PPE kit (mask, gloves, goggles). Restricted entry interval: 24 hours. Do not spray during flowering when bees are active. Follow CIB&RC label instructions strictly.
description: Premium anthranilic diamide insecticide with excellent larvicidal action and long residual control.

name: Confidor (Imidacloprid 17.8% SL)
dosage: 40-50 ml per acre in 200 litres water; seed treatment 5ml/kg seed for sucking pests.
targetUse: Controls aphids, jassids, whitefly and thrips - key sucking pest complex.
safety: Highly toxic to bees — avoid spraying during flowering. Wear full PPE. Keep out of reach of children.
description: Trusted systemic insecticide from Bayer with rapid knockdown against sucking pests.

name: Glyphosate 41% SL
dosage: 1-1.5 litre per acre in 150-200 litres water for pre-plant / bund application.
targetUse: Broad-spectrum control of perennial and annual weeds including Cynodon (Kunda).
safety: RESTRICTED USE — not for use in standing food crops without label clearance. Wear full protective clothing. Avoid drift onto crop foliage. Follow state regulatory advisories on Glyphosate usage.
description: Systemic non-selective herbicide for pre-sowing land preparation and bund/orchard weed management.

name: Saaf (Carbendazim 12% + Mancozeb 63% WP)
dosage: 500-600 gm per acre in 200 litres water; repeat at 10-12 day interval.
targetUse: Controls purple blotch, powdery mildew, rust, leaf spot and blight diseases.
safety: Avoid inhalation of powder. Use mask while mixing. Wash hands thoroughly after use.
description: India's most trusted broad-spectrum combination fungicide — systemic plus contact action.

name: Bavistin (Carbendazim 50% WP)
dosage: 200 gm per acre spray / 2gm per kg seed for seed treatment.
targetUse: Controls seed & soil borne diseases, wilt, root rot and smut.
safety: Use gloves while handling. Not to be mixed with alkaline pesticides.
description: Broad spectrum systemic fungicide effective as both seed treatment and foliar spray.

name: Bt Cotton Hybrid Seeds (Bollgard II)
dosage: 1 packet (450gm) sufficient for 1 acre at 3x1 ft spacing.
targetUse: Built-in resistance to bollworm complex; suited for irrigated black cotton soil.
safety: Government-notified MRP packet. Plant refuge crop as per CICR guidelines.
description: MahaBt hybrid cotton seed with strong boll retention and staple length, popular across Vidarbha & Marathwada.

name: Soybean Seeds JS-9560
dosage: 30 kg bag sufficient for 1 acre at recommended row spacing 45x5 cm.
targetUse: High-yield early maturing variety (95-100 days), tolerant to yellow mosaic virus.
safety: Store in cool dry place; treat with Thiram/Carbendazim before sowing.
description: Popular short-duration soybean variety well suited to Marathwada rainfed conditions.

name: Onion Seeds - Bhima Shakti
dosage: 500 gm sufficient for 1 acre nursery bed.
targetUse: Dark red, medium-pungent bulbs with good storage life — Rabi season variety.
safety: Sow in raised nursery beds; treat with Trichoderma before sowing to prevent damping off.
description: High-demand storage onion variety developed for Maharashtra's Nashik-Ahmednagar belt.

name: Wheat Seeds - Lokwan (HD-2189)
dosage: 40 kg bag per acre broadcast/drill sowing.
targetUse: Rabi season bread wheat with strong local market demand for chapati quality.
safety: Treat seed with fungicide before sowing to prevent loose smut.
description: Traditional favourite Lokwan wheat variety valued for its taste and milling quality.

name: Humic Acid Granules 98%
activeIngredient: Humic Acid 98% w/w derived from Leonardite
dosage: 2-3 kg per acre mixed with soil or FYM; can be applied via drip irrigation.
targetUse: Improves soil structure, nutrient uptake efficiency and root proliferation.
safety: Non-hazardous. Store in a dry place.
description: Concentrated humic acid granules that boost fertilizer use efficiency and soil microbial activity.

name: Knapsack Sprayer 16L (Manual)
dosage: N/A
targetUse: Manual lever-operated backpack sprayer for pesticide/fertilizer foliar application.
safety: Rinse thoroughly after each use, especially after herbicide spraying.
description: Durable HDPE tank knapsack sprayer with brass nozzle, ideal for 1-2 acre daily spraying.

name: Power Weeder / Brush Cutter
dosage: N/A
targetUse: Inter-row weeding and grass cutting in orchards, sugarcane and field bunds.
safety: Wear safety goggles and boots while operating. Keep children away during use.
description: 4-stroke engine power weeder — reduces manual weeding labour cost significantly.

name: Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG
dosage: 80-100 gm per acre in 200 litres water.
targetUse: Effective against Spodoptera (armyworm), bollworm and diamondback moth.
safety: Use full PPE. Pre-harvest interval 5-7 days depending on crop.
description: Widely used biorational insecticide for lepidopteran pest control with low mammalian toxicity.

name: Potassium Schoenite (Sulphate of Potash)
dosage: 1 bag per acre split across vegetative and flowering stage.
targetUse: Improves fruit/bulb quality, disease resistance and drought tolerance; chloride-free.
safety: Store in dry conditions away from direct sunlight.
description: Chloride-free potash source, preferred for chloride-sensitive crops like onion and tobacco.

name: Metribuzin 70% WP
dosage: 210 gm per acre as pre-emergence spray within 2-3 days of sowing.
targetUse: Controls broadleaf weeds and grasses in soybean and wheat fields.
safety: Use flat-fan nozzle for even coverage. Avoid application on sandy soils with low organic matter.
description: Pre-emergence herbicide widely recommended for soybean weed management programs.

name: Trichoderma Viride Bio-fungicide
dosage: 4-5 gm per kg seed for treatment; 2 kg per acre mixed with FYM for soil application.
targetUse: Biological control of soil-borne pathogens - damping off, wilt, root rot.
safety: Eco-friendly bio-input, safe for beneficial soil organisms. Avoid mixing with chemical fungicides.
description: Organic bio-fungicide that builds long-term soil health while suppressing root diseases.
